precepts.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. The Lord never gave us that spirit. Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God.
precepts.point: This is the king. If the king is scared, what is that going to do to the men under him? If the officer is fearful, it spreads to the soldiers under him.
precepts.why:
“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear.” The Bible says the Lord never gave us that spirit. So the fear Saul had when his heart greatly trembled goes back into a lack of faith.

“But of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” We are supposed to have the spirit of power, love and a sound mind.

“Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God.” We are not supposed to be ashamed of the testimony of Christ. The bashful brother is ashamed and afraid; the one who has God’s spirit partakes of the afflictions of the gospel by the power of God.

precepts.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? Hope thou in God, for I shall yet praise him. David is saying I may be down but I am not out; I still have fight in me. Some of you run out the minute correction comes. Correction is a good thing: it keeps you on your toes, makes you stronger, and Moses said to correct some openly so others fear. Never keep yes-men around you; a man in your circle who cannot correct you hates you and is waiting for your downfall, and the same goes for the sister who will not tell you what you want to hear.
precepts.point: Some of you will betray the brother next to you out of fear, because Esau threatens to tell the congregation what you were watching; your mind was in porn instead of the scriptures. With AI they will set many of us up with fake video, and some of our own people will believe it with no proof because they never built their minds in the scriptures.
precepts.why:
“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear”. When fear or trouble tries to put you down, David shows how to talk to your own soul: “Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.”

David is speaking to himself, to his soul. Put plain: I might be down, but I'm not broken. I might be down, but I'm not out yet. Satan tried to take me out, but I'm still fighting. My hope is in the Lord, and I still have some fight in me.

Some of you are quick to give up. As soon as something happens, you run out: why did they have to put correction? Correction is a good thing. It keeps you on your toes, it makes you better and stronger. What doesn't break you makes you stronger; that is correction, that is the word of God. You can use a brother's correction to build yourself up: in my mind I was going to do what this brother got corrected for, so let me move from it. Moses said some you correct openly, so that others fear. Some of you never were corrected in your life until you came to IUIC, and you are too prideful to take it.

Brothers, never keep a yes-man around you. If you have a man in your circle who cannot say, bro, I don't think you should do this, that man hates you and is waiting for your downfall. You want men who tell you, don't talk evil of leadership; if you have a problem with a brother, go to him. Sisters are the same: the sister who won't tell you what you want to hear is not your enemy, she is the one you want around you, because she has no respect of persons. Men like that help you get the kingdom of heaven.

precepts.text: I am feeble and sore broken; I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart. Lord, all my desire is before thee. Some of you never pray for yourself because you think you are perfect. When you fast, ask Messiah to help you overcome your lust or your covetous spirit; we all have lust, though it differs.
precepts.point: Some of you will betray the brother next to you out of fear, because Esau threatens to tell the congregation what you were watching; your mind was in porn instead of the scriptures. With AI they will set many of us up with fake video, and some of our own people will believe it with no proof because they never built their minds in the scriptures.
precepts.why:
David was down but not out, and he did not hide it from God: “I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.” To roar is to utter or express in a loud tone: to cry, shout, yell. David says, I'm feeble, I'm broken, and I cried out because of the disquietness of my heart.

“Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.” He laid it all before the Lord.

Some of you, when you pray, do not pray for yourself, because you think you are perfect. You need to pray for yourself and ask for help to overcome certain things. Some of you are fighting lust; when you fast, pray that Messiah helps you overcome that lust. We all have lust. Our lust might be different things, but we all have it. Some of you are fighting a covetous spirit; pray that Messiah helps you overcome it.

You are not going to walk into the kingdom of heaven thinking you're perfect and your stuff don't stink. Put your desire and your groaning before the Lord, so that when the storm comes, fear does not overtake you.

precepts.text: He that overcometh and keepeth my works unto the end. You must overcome the lust of America and your personal struggle: porn, prostitution, drugs, weed, cigarettes, Black and Milds, women. Keep my works means keep my commandments; if you keep them you have overcome, and if not you are not making it, so do not count yourself in when you watch these prophecies.
precepts.point: Some of you will betray the brother next to you out of fear, because Esau threatens to tell the congregation what you were watching; your mind was in porn instead of the scriptures. With AI they will set many of us up with fake video, and some of our own people will believe it with no proof because they never built their minds in the scriptures.
precepts.why:
You won't walk into the kingdom thinking you are perfect. This is what Christ said: “And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations”.

The word is overcome. Brothers, you must overcome the lust of America, and you must also overcome the personal thing you struggle with. We all struggle with things. Some of you struggle with lust, with porn, with prostitution, with drugs. Some of you are crackheads, weed heads; some of you it's cigarettes, Black and Milds, women. And yes, it is said to shame you. This is not my word; don't get mad at me. Read what Christ says you have to do.

The words “keepeth my works” mean keep my commandments, keep my laws. My works is this book: keep it. If you keep it, that means you have overcome. You must overcome, or else you are not going to make it to the kingdom.

So when you watch all these prophecies happen, don't include yourself if you won't let the lust go. Some of you need to let things go. That is how you keep from the spirit of fear: you prepare your mind in the scriptures and overcome, so that Esau has nothing to hold over you and you don't betray your brother to hide what you were watching.

precepts.text: Gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity. You are that gold; some of you want to be iron or silver. Gold is purified in the fire, and if you will not let the unclean be purged out you cannot have the kingdom. Esau has put you through hell all your life; do not lose the kingdom on top of it by holding on to things from five, twenty, or fifty years ago like a woman bringing up the pineapple when you are talking about the orange. It takes a strong man to take correction; when correction comes, push harder to prove to Messiah you are still in the fight.
precepts.point: Some of you will betray the brother next to you out of fear, because Esau threatens to tell the congregation what you were watching; your mind was in porn instead of the scriptures. With AI they will set many of us up with fake video, and some of our own people will believe it with no proof because they never built their minds in the scriptures.
precepts.why:
“For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.” You are that gold. We are that gold. How do you purify gold? By putting it in the fire. Some of you need to go into the fire. You have stuff on you that has to be purged out, but you want to keep it and still have the kingdom of heaven. If you don't want to be purged, you cannot get the kingdom. Some of you want to be iron, some of you want to be silver; you have to be that gold.

What is the purpose of going through all that and not getting the kingdom? Esau has been putting you through hell all your life, and you end up missing the kingdom because you hold on to things and don't want God to take the unclean out of you.

Some of you hold on to things that happened fifty years ago, twenty years ago, five years ago. That's like a woman in an argument: you're talking about the orange and she says, yeah, but the pineapple happened five years ago. There's no pineapple here; we're talking about the orange. Some sisters got notes, waiting to bring them out. Men should not be emotional like that.

And “acceptable men in the furnace of adversity”: it takes a strong man to take correction. Weak men cannot. When correction comes, the strong man gets up, repents and keeps moving, and you can tell he is still in the fight. When you get correction, that's when you push harder. Don't lay back. Prove to Messiah, not to leadership, that you are still in the fight.

precepts.text: By the coming of our Lord and our gathering together unto him, be not soon shaken in mind by spirit, word, or letter as from us, that the day of Christ is at hand. People forged Paul's letters, as the FBI wrote letters in the Panthers' names in the sixties. That day shall not come except there come a falling away first: all twelve tribes falling into captivity, Luke 21:24, led away captive into all nations until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. Judah, Benjamin, and Levi had not fallen completely in Paul's day, but 70 AD was approaching.
precepts.point: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes: men who warred with Paul left the faith. We have seen a lot come and a lot go, so do not get too attached; you are strong today, we will see about tomorrow when affliction, tribulation, and persecution come. The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus, who oft refreshed me, was not ashamed of my chain, and in Rome sought me out very diligently on foot, and ministered unto me at Ephesus; may he find mercy of the Lord in that day.
precepts.why:
Paul told Timothy he was persuaded that Christ “is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.” Paul committed his soul, his life, to Christ. What day? Thessalonians explains it: “Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him.” That day is the second coming, and all twelve tribes can only gather unto Christ.

“That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.” People were writing letters in Paul’s name saying the second coming had already happened and you missed it. Paul said, I don’t care if you got a letter signed by me, I didn’t write that; that day did not happen yet. Remember in the sixties the FBI would write letters to the Black Panthers and other black organizations in each other’s names. They were doing the same thing with Paul.

“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first.” Christ is not going to return until all twelve tribes fall away into captivity. Christians break that down as people leaving Christianity; it is not talking about that crap. It is falling into captivity, as Luke 21:24 says: “they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.” All twelve shall fall, and we are still living in the times of the Gentiles.

In Paul’s day, Judah, Benjamin and Levi had not fallen completely; they were still in the land. But 70 AD was soon approaching. So the day Paul committed his soul against has not come yet, and it could not come until all of us fell. And we all fell.

precepts.text: The sun shall be turned into darkness and the moon into blood, war and devastation, before the great and terrible day of the Lord come. Amos 5:18: woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord; it is darkness and not light, not the party you imagine. Zephaniah 1:14-15: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly; that day is a day of wrath, trouble, and distress. Matthew 24:29-30: after the tribulation the stars, missiles, fall from heaven, the powers of the nations are shaken with war, and all the tribes of the earth mourn when they see the Son of man coming. We will be running and weeping, not stomping and clapping.
precepts.point: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes: men who warred with Paul left the faith. We have seen a lot come and a lot go, so do not get too attached; you are strong today, we will see about tomorrow when affliction, tribulation, and persecution come. The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus, who oft refreshed me, was not ashamed of my chain, and in Rome sought me out very diligently on foot, and ministered unto me at Ephesus; may he find mercy of the Lord in that day.
precepts.why:
“That day” in Paul’s words to Timothy is the second coming, and Joel shows what kind of day it is: “The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the Lord come.” This is a time of war and devastation. When Christ returns, it is going to be a great and terrible day.

Amos says the same: “Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! to what end is it for you? the day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.” We say we can’t wait for the day of the Lord because we don’t really comprehend the magnitude of what is going to happen. You think it is going to be a bright day and Christ will take us all up to the kingdom. It is not that type of a day; it is not that type of a party.

Zephaniah: “The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly. That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress.” Don’t think that when the Lord returns we are all going to be standing and cheering. We are going to be running and weeping.

Christ said it in Matthew 24: “Immediately after the tribulation of those days”, which is Jacob’s trouble, “shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light”, because the sky will be black, “and the stars shall fall from heaven”: missiles dropping from the sky. The powers of the nations shall be shaken with war. “and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.” You think you will be happy, stomping your feet and clapping; the Bible says all the tribes shall mourn, meaning cry bitterly. That is the day Paul was preparing Timothy for, and why he told him to stir up the gift, not fear, and not be ashamed of the afflictions of the gospel.

precepts.text: God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. Christ told the disciples to sell a garment and buy a sword, and some are still scared to.
precepts.point: Now it is high time to awake out of sleep, for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed. Prepare for war mentally; with all this going on in the earth, staying spiritually asleep is madness.
precepts.why:
“Now it is high time to awake out of sleep”. We see all these things going on and some of y’all still stay asleep, not even paying attention to what is going on in the earth. Y’all crazy as hell. You need to prepare ye war, and the first place to prepare is the mind: guard your mind from fear.

“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” God gave you power, love and a sound mind. Some of y’all are scared. Christ told them to sell their garment and buy a sword, and some are still scared to buy one. Christ said do it.

There is a time and place for everything under the sun, and that time is going to come. So prepare mentally. We are a nonviolent people; all we want to do is serve the Lord. But we will protect and defend ourselves.

Waking out of sleep means not letting fear keep you from doing what Christ commanded. “Now is our salvation nearer than when we believed”, and a mind given power, love and soundness by God is ready for what is coming.

precepts.text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
precepts.point: The Lord had willed them to go up, but these men were so out of the spirit that they forgot He had already destroyed mightier nations before them. An evil report spreads a spirit of fear, but the Most High has not given His people the spirit of fear.

note.label: Numbers 13: The Spies Search the Land

precepts.why:
Caleb said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.” But the men that went up with him said, “We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we”, and brought up an evil report, and were in their own sight as grasshoppers.

An evil report spreads a spirit of fear. But “God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” The Lord had willed them to go up, and these men were so out of the spirit that they forgot He had already destroyed mightier nations before them.

The fear was not from the Most High. What He gives His people is power, love, and a sound mind, and that is the spirit Caleb spoke from.

precepts.text: God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
precepts.point: The principle still applies: the body still has adversaries that rise against it, and the command remains to be in nothing terrified by them. Fear of the adversary is a spirit the Most High never gave his people; whoever is terrified of the enemy is out of the Spirit.

note.label: Deuteronomy 1: The Second Giving of the Law

precepts.why:
“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” Fear of the adversary is a spirit, and the Most High never gave it to his people. When Israel dreaded the Amorites after all they had seen in Egypt and in the wilderness, that fear did not come from the Lord.

So whoever is terrified of the enemy is out of the Spirit. What the Lord gives is power, love, and a sound mind, and a sound mind remembers what he did in Egypt before our eyes and how he bare us in all the way that we went. “Dread not, neither be afraid of them” is not only a command; it is the Spirit the Most High actually gave.

precepts.text: God hath not given us the spirit of fear; do not be afraid in this battle.
precepts.point: Fear makes people trim their ways: afraid of family at the pagan holiday table, tucking their fringes in certain places, scared to be seen in the truth. Stand boldly; the Lord has not given us the spirit of fear, for that spirit came from Satan himself.

note.label: Deuteronomy 20: Laws of Warfare and the Spirit of Fear

precepts.why:
“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” Moses said be not afraid of them, and Paul says the same: do not be afraid in this battle.

Fear makes people trim their ways: afraid of family at the pagan holiday table, tucking their fringes in certain places, scared to be seen in the truth. Stand boldly. The Lord has not given us the spirit of fear, for that spirit came from Satan himself; what he gave is power, love, and a sound mind.

precepts.text: God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind; if the spirit of fear comes upon you, it is not of God.
precepts.point: Have not I commanded thee: not being afraid is a commandment. Fear does not come from the Most High; the only fear he deals with is fearing him and the judgments you suffer for disobeying him. Being scared of what man can do to you is a spirit from the devil, not from God.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
“Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed”. Not being afraid is a commandment. “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.”

Fear does not come from the Most High; the only fear he deals with is fearing him and the judgments you suffer for disobeying him. Being scared of what man can do to you is a spirit from the devil, not from God. If the spirit of fear comes upon you, it is not of God. The Lord gave us the spirit of power; as long as you serve and obey him, there is nothing to be scared of.

precepts.text: The Lord did not give us the spirit of fear; for the people of the Most High, fearfulness before the enemy is unbelief.
precepts.point: Nehemiah shows the right spirit. In the Persian captivity he had liberty from the king to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem, and the enemies Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem plotted to scare him off the work. A hired man urged him to hide in the temple because they were coming to slay him, and Nehemiah refused; operating in the spirit of fear is sin according to the scripture.

note.label: 1 Samuel 13: Make Not Haste in Time of Trouble

precepts.why:
“For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” The Lord did not give us the spirit of fear.

As the chosen people, if we really have faith we should be fearless. For the people of the Most High, fearfulness before the enemy is unbelief. The Lord had just defeated the Philistines for Israel; to still fear the enemy shows a lack of faith, that you really do not believe in your God.

precepts.text: The Most High hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind; the fear in the camp was not his spirit.
precepts.point: The Most High put laws in the book about going to battle, and this fear showed that Saul and the people lacked faith; the same God that destroyed Pharaoh and the Egyptians who pursued Israel was with them, and a trial of faith was set before them in the form of one big intimidating man with a big mouth.

note.label: 1 Samuel 17: Not by Sword and Spear

precepts.why:
Goliath cried unto the armies of Israel, “choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.” If he kills me, we will be your servants; if I prevail and kill him, ye shall be our servants. “I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.” “When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.”

They were in a carnal spirit, measuring his height, his armor and his reach. The spirit had departed, and fear is not the spirit of the Most High: “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” The fear in the camp was not his spirit.

With AI they will set many of us up with fake video, and some of our own people will believe it with no proof because they never built their minds in the scriptures.

Stir up the gift of God which is in thee: Timothy had the Holy Spirit, and not stirring it up is burying your talent in a napkin. Who hath saved us and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began. You were not called for something magnanimous you did; God saw greatness in you that you did not know was there, and we were with the Lord in the beginning. Ephesians 1:4, chosen in him before the foundation of the world, before the earth was made on the third day. You have more in you than you think.

Hold fast the form of sound words, the doctrine we teach; it will enrich you personally, your marriage, your family, and the nation. That good thing committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us. John 14:26: the Comforter shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance, because in captivity we would lose our identity and think we were Afro-American, Puerto Rican, or Dominican. The Holy Ghost being back is the evidence.

This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes: men who warred with Paul left the faith. We have seen a lot come and a lot go, so do not get too attached; you are strong today, we will see about tomorrow when affliction, tribulation, and persecution come. The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus, who oft refreshed me, was not ashamed of my chain, and in Rome sought me out very diligently on foot, and ministered unto me at Ephesus; may he find mercy of the Lord in that day.
The grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began, so we were predestined to receive mercy before we were formed in the womb.
That is why he told Jeremiah, Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee.
